refnamediv.refpurpose: Output a BMP image to browser or file

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
boolimagebmp GdImageimage resourcestringnullfile&null; boolcompressed&true;
Outputs or saves a BMP version of the given image.
The bit depth of the BMP is chosen from the image; it cannot be specified:
A truecolor image is saved with 32 bits per pixel, including its alpha channel, if at least one of its pixels is not fully opaque, and with 24 bits per pixel otherwise.
A palette image is saved with 1 bit per pixel if its palette has at most 2 colors, with 4 bits per pixel if it has at most 16 colors, and with 8 bits per pixel otherwise. The number of colors in the palette is the one returned by imagecolorstotal.
This applies to the bundled GD library as of PHP 8.6.0. Older versions of the GD library, including the bundled one prior to PHP 8.6.0, save truecolor images with 24 bits per pixel, without their alpha channel, and palette images with 8 bits per pixel.
